                      2 Everyone  had to fall into line and work longer hours for the same pay.
                        The deal fell foul of the export regulations and had to be cancelled at the last minute.

                        The report falls short of an outright condemnation of the government’s actions, but it does

             59.3
                        | didn’t realise she was deceiving me, and | fell for it hook, line and sinker.
                     eH
                        It looks as if the whole system is falling apart at the seams.
                        | didn’t really have to do anything to get the job. It just fell into my lap.
                        Sara may  not like the new rules, but she’ll just have to fall into line.

             59.4
                      1  If you fall for a thing (e.g. a trick or a lie) hook, line and sinker, you believe it completely. If you fall
                        for a person hook, line and sinker, you fall madly in love with them.
                      2  Pride comes before a fall.
                      3  False. If someone falls over themselves to do something, it means they are very keen and eager to
                        do  it.
                      4 The  bigger they are / come, the harder they fall.

             60.2
                      1  | must think of a way of getting my own back on Matt for playing that trick on me.
